Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_chat_round42.py — status default online, HH:MM validation 400, offline-window auto reply with placeholder substitution, no-repeat-within-6h, quick-reply still returns its own quick answer when offline, /me/chat/sessions 401/200 + guest_id filter + last_message!='' exclusion, admin context member/guest/404, admin order lookup q<4 → []. Frontend admin: logged in via /admin/login + TOTP, opened 客服會話 → chat-hours-manage opens chat-hours-modal; all required testids present (chat-hours-enabled, chat-hours-start, chat-hours-end, chat-hours-tz, chat-hours-message, chat-hours-save); changed message, saved, reopened → persisted correctly. admin-sound-toggle opens admin-sound-panel; admin-desktop-enabled toggle on → localStorage.admin_sound = {"enabled":true,"volume":0.8,"desktop":true}. Hours restored to disabled at the end (quick replies & chat_hours settings reset by test teardown).
action_items: (nice-to-have, not blocking) In ChatAdmin.jsx the session-list wrapper has data-testid='chat-session-list' which collides with the prefix 'chat-session-' used by individual rows (chat-session-<sid>). Playwright selectors like [data-testid^="chat-session-"] match both the list container AND the rows, which is confusing for tests. Suggest renaming the container testid to e.g. 'chat-sessions-list' to disambiguate.
critical_code_review_comments: chat_api.open_session: when a logged-in user already has an open session the find_one $or uses user_id OR guest_id, so a new guest_id is force-written onto the previously existing session. Fine behaviorally, but means /me/chat/sessions with ?guest_id=newGuest can return sessions whose stored guest_id was overwritten — tests have to insert session docs directly to assert last_message='' exclusion.

user_send after-hours block runs AFTER status is reset to 'open'. If a session was previously 'handled' and user sends a non-quick message while offline, the session is reopened AND auto-reply fires. Matches spec ('sending to a handled session reopens it').

/admin/chat/orders uses re.escape on q then regex-matches order_no OR user_email OR id. No index hint, uses full-collection scan; for larger order collections consider a $text index or exact-match fast path.

chat_hours DEFAULT_HOURS.message uses {start}/{end}/{tz} placeholders — hours_message only replaces those literal strings; if admins add additional {foo} placeholders they'll leak into the auto reply. Low-risk.
Admin side-panel ContextPanel polls on every selected session change only (not on an interval) — good; combined with the pre-existing 3s thread poll traffic is unchanged.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (hours modal + desktop notif + widget status fully verified; chat-context-panel UI click flow not asserted via Playwright because the chat-session-list parent testid shadows [data-testid^=chat-session-] prefix selectors — backend context endpoint is fully covered by passing tests)
